suffix: Immaculately maintained red brick apartment block of three levels, set back behind established gardens and mature trees in a quiet, leafy street. Secure entry, well-kept common grounds and off-street access.

Spacious open-plan living and dining area with fresh neutral paintwork, quality carpet and wide windows framing a leafy district outlook. Generous proportions allow for a separate lounge and dining setting, with the hallway leading through to the bedrooms.

Renovated u-shaped kitchen with stone-look benchtops, subway tiled splashback and abundant white cabinetry. Appointed with a stainless steel oven, gas cooktop, rangehood and dishwasher, plus full-size fridge space, double sink and timber flooring underfoot.
Generous main bedroom comfortably accommodating a queen bed and bedside furniture, with soft carpet, neutral walls and a large picture window capturing a green, tree-lined outlook.

Full bathroom in original retro tiling, presenting a separate bathtub and glass-screened shower, wide vanity with mirrored cabinet, separate toilet and a frosted window for natural light and ventilation.
